This is an extremely healthy Broncos team with Marvin Mims, the only name on the injury report, going into this game. What do you think the approach is for Denver early on in this season, after a training camp in which they dealt with some annoying little things here and there, to just try and get through the hot part of the schedule nice and healthy? Yeah, you know, it's been their focus. I mean, Sean Payton basically announced he was, you know, forbidding any more injuries at one point in camp. So... I think they've tried very hard. This is the longest stretch between a final preseason game and an opener that I can remember a team having, and certainly any team I've ever covered never had a gap like this. So I think the challenge has been to do, you know, just sort of stay sharp, not be stale, and not keep guys on the field so long that you have those injuries pop up because you're You know, you just keep going at it. I remember vividly a Fangio camp one year when they just kept grinding after the last preseason game, and that team came out of the gate as poorly as I can ever remember. So I think they've been real cognizant of trying to keep everybody on the field healthy. You know, they didn't take as many veteran rest days as he sort of implied. in camp, but I think they've managed their time on the field and kind of what they did in each of those drills. And I think today is even an example. They sort of made today a recovery day for players, you know, to go in and use all of the new facilities they have now that a lot of teams don't. So I think you're seeing sort of the whole portfolio now of the new facility and what it means. Jeff, along those lines, you know, we were talking earlier in the show last night and you know, the Rams and Niners game and you saw, uh, Kalen black 15 touches along with 15 touches for Christian McCaffrey. All right, let's kind of translate that to Denver with JK Dobbins, like known, known likely injury case for the Broncos as he has been throughout his career. Um, is it possible that we could see kind of a distribution of touches quite similar to what Kyle Shanahan is trying to do to get McCaffrey to the finish line healthy? Yes, to all of the above. I'll pinky swear to that. With me? The Broncos will be the most frustrating team for many fantasy football aficionados. And a lot of it, frankly, is going to matter about who they're playing and what kind of packages they're in. I will say they've held a lot back of their offensive tweaks so far, and a lot of those are in the run game, and there are several two-back sets and not– fullback running back to back, but two running back sets in the, in the playbook. And I guess I'll be intrigued early on to see how often we see those to sort of get those snaps to those guys. Cause I think they feel better in terms of production point production and first down production, all those things that, with the addition of waddle and what they have at running back now, that may be the replacement for sort of tight end touches in some of those times when they're in a heavier set. All right. Chris Jones all of a sudden pops up on the injury report today with a calf injury. Jeff, how big would that be for the Broncos is an obvious question. Easy one for you right here.
